exploit_name: Liquidation bonus underflow blocks liquidation of distribution-insolvent accounts
description: Cross-denominated bonus calculation assumes thresholdCross >= balanceCross, but distribution insolvency (one token below requirement while another has surplus) causes balanceCross > thresholdCross. Unsigned arithmetic underflows and reverts.
attack_scenario: High utilization disables cross-margining. User holds large token0 surplus but token1 deficit. Liquidation call reverts on bonus calculation.
root_cause: Cross-denominated bonus calculation assumes thresholdCross >= balanceCross, but distribution insolvency (one token below requirement while another has surplus) causes balanceCross > thresholdCross. Unsigned arithmetic underflows and reverts.
fix_description: Clamp the deficit: uint256 deficitCross = thresholdCross > balanceCross ? thresholdCross - balanceCross : 0;
notes: Liquidation DoS — accounts deemed liquidatable become unliquidatable, increasing probability of PLP losses.
